proposed_widenings.name: set_size
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait's core mechanic is a temporary transformation to Large size, which cannot be represented by any existing EffectAtom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.abilityCheckAbilityFilter
proposed_widenings.justification: The current roll-advantage surface can narrow ability checks by skill or condition, but not by underlying ability. This trait needs Strength-only check filtering.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks

proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord.acquiredAtCharacterLevel
proposed_widenings.justification: Species traits can currently be authored as always available, but this trait unlocks only at character level 5.

notes: No authored content file was created. The unit mostly matches species_trait + activation, but its core size-change mechanic is missing from the atom surface, and Strength-check narrowing plus species-trait level gating are also absent.
